page_title: FIO 0-0 PAR | Fiorentina v Parma 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Fiorentina was in an offside position.
90+1' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90+1' Alessandro Circati (Parma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Good work from Parma as they win a corner.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dodo (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
89' The resulting corner from Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) is cleared by the defence.
87' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
86' Marin Pongracic will be replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
86' Substitution. Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) on for Cher Ndour.
84' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
82' Carlos Cuesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nahuel Estevez (Parma) replacing Oliver Sorensen.
82' Dodo (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch for Jack Harrison.
76' The ball is cleared after Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
72' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gabriel Strefezza.
72' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Nesta Elphege (Parma) replaces Mateo Pellegrino.
69' Luca Zufferli has a clear sight and sees a foul from Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
67' Parma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
64' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) replaces Rolando Mandragora.
63' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.

59' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
58' Corner kick. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.
54' Substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia will be replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
54' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Edoardo Corvi (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.
52' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
48' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) was waiting for the ball on the penalty spot and produced a powerful volley low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
47' A pass from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Edoardo Corvi and the move breaks down.
47' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' A short pass finds Enrico Delprato (Parma) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
42' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes.
39' Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
36' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Edoardo Corvi (Parma).
36' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' Luca Zufferli blows for a foul after Mariano Troilo (Parma) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Parma string together a series of short passes.
29' Dodo (Fiorentina) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
26' This shall not pass! Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
24' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Luca Zufferli immediately signals a free kick.
23' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Zufferli who sees an offensive foul.

19' What a chance that is! Emanuele Valeri (Parma) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
17' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Edoardo Corvi comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

15' Jack Harrison (Fiorentina) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
14' Fiorentina show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
13' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails high over the bar.
11' Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
10' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
9' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
8' Dodo (Fiorentina) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
7' Benjamin Cremaschi (Parma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
6' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' A neat pass is well received by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Parma will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Zufferli.
